lines: Ah... there you are. Welcome, darling.
Now then — how are you? Are you well?
I do hope your spirits have been high so far.
Aphrodite hums to herself, waiting.
Well, of course. I'm the goddess of beauty.
Hm. So not even a goddess of beauty is enough for you...
But tell me — what do you think makes a woman beautiful?
Ah, never mind — it's too early for silly questions like that. You're not here for this...
I mean, actually, that's not even— ...ugh, I'm bored.
I wanted to send you on a task. Are you ready?
What do you mean, no?

options.label: I changed my mind — I do feel ready

lines: Whether you're ready didn't really matter. I'm a goddess — I asked to be polite.
If I want something, you'll do it.
Then why even ask? I didn't come here to do tasks — I don't even know what this is about yet.
Fine.
Fine...?
Fine. Okay.
Well — okay then. So what am I supposed to do?
Why are you asking me? Do whatever you want.
You're right — springing a task on you out of nowhere was cliché and unpleasant. Make yourself at home.
Thanks for understanding.
Lovely. Just as it should be. Do you want to hear your task?
Hmmm, let's see, let's see... what could this task you wanted so badly even be?
Alright, I'll tell you: find true love.
WHAT?
What's wrong?
Even if there is such a thing as true love, finding it isn't as easy as... it's not like going to the store and grabbing 3 eggs, it's kind of a—
Shhh — calm down, tiny one. I never said this would be an easy task.
Besides, what were you expecting? The goddess of love telling you to go grab a carrot???
Hmm... wait a second. You actually have 2 tasks now, sweetheart — the carrot craving hit.
This has to be a joke. I'm out.
If this disrespect keeps up, yes — you'll be out. Permanently.
...so I don't really have a choice, then.
Well, it's a task — you need to do it. Besides, you wanted this so badly, you begged for it.
Come on, tiny one, we gods need to have fun too. Besides, what's the worst that could happen?
Is there something in it for me, at least?
There's no greater reward than love, child. Besides, the adventures along the road to love are the stuff of legend.
Okay — how much time do I have, where do I even find it, I mean what am I supposed to d—
First — calm down. Time: hmm, until I get bored of waiting. Where you'll find it is up to you, but don't worry, I'll start you off somewhere. I'll be watching.
...Okay. I'll get going, then.
Before you go, let me remind you of a few things.
Run, and you die. Annoy me, or refuse to carry out your task, and I'll make it worse than death for you. Understood, love?
Good. Now — before love comes the carrot, since the goddess had a craving. Good luck!
Wait, right no—
Aphrodite snaps her fingers — the room dissolves, and you're standing in a forest.
Ohh — you actually brought it. Thank you, sweetie.
Aphrodite takes a bite of the carrot, humming contentedly.
Mm. Delicious. Now then — let's see how you do with the rest.
If you get bored, you can go to the room next door.

options.label: Why would you think I'm bored? I'm having a blast on my own.
